name: Leon County, FL
findings: Leon County has 1,586 nonprofit organizations. 672 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 575 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Leon County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
